name: bge real-frame night split v1
night_id_definition: local date of sunset: a timestamp before local noon belongs to the previous date (achernar-daemon/src/storage/night.rs, tools/import_session.py night_id_for)
order: nights sorted by the earliest timestamp_utc of any frame (light, dark, bias or flat) assigned to the night; nights with no timestamp sort after timestamped ones; ties and untimestamped nights by night_id
holdout_positions: 1-based positions 2, 4, 6, ... in that order are hold-out; 1, 3, 5, ... are development
calibration_frames: darks, bias and flats belong to the split of their night
within_night: a night is never split; every frame of a night carries the night's split
rationale: frames within a night share seeing, transparency, sky brightness, tube temperature and focus state, so the night is the independent unit; alternating assignment keeps both splits spread over the campaign
